evidence_excerpts: FACTUAL-GROUNDING p1, p2, … < q iff: (i) p1 Ù p2 Ù … ⊑∨ q; and (ii) neither q ⊑∧∨ p1, nor q ⊑∧∨ p2, nor …
text: Factual grounding is analyzed through disjunctive parthood: a plurality of facts grounds q exactly when their conjunction is a disjunctive part of q and q is not a relevant conjunctive-disjunctive part of any ground.
